Fighting that reads the challenger: Meditite and Machoke break defences, Hitmontop hits first with Fake Out and Mach Punch, Monferno's Mach Punch follows, and Riolu's line, now Lucario, finishes with Force Palm and its aura.
Water at full stream: Quagsire stands on Water Absorb, Gyarados frightens with Intimidate, Pelipper calls the rain with Rain Dance, and Floatzel's Swift Swim finishes in it.
Steel that will not fall: Bronzor reflects, Skarmory lays Spikes, Magneton shocks, Steelix crushes, and Bastiodon stands to the last with Sturdy and Metal Burst.
Cold and dark: Sneasel strikes first, Golbat confuses, Kadabra disables, and Murkrow ends it with Feint Attack and Night Shade.
Precise and poisonous: Bronzor reflects, Golbat confuses, Skuntank smokes and Toxicroak breaks through.
Pressure on the lake: Golbat and Bronzor wear down, Drapion's Pursuit and Purugly's Fake Out finish.
